info.name: Academic Graph Author Data Release Data API

items.docs: Releases are identified by a date stamp such as "2023-08-01". Each release contains full data for each dataset.

info.name: List of Datasets in a Release

items.docs: Metadata describing a particular release, including a list of datasets available.

Datasets are partitioned and stored on S3. Clients can retrieve them by requesting this list
of pre-signed download urls and fetching all the partitions.
